with a_source as (
    select
        aa.tracking_number                                          as tracking_number,
        min(coalesce(cc.platform_order_number, bb.platform_order_number)) as platform_order_number,
        min(upper(bb.logistics_provider_code))                      as logistics_carrier_code,
        min(bb.shop_code)                                           as shop_code,
        min(bb.warehouse_code)                                      as warehouse_code,
        min(bb.zone)                                                as zone,
        count(*)                                                    as source_row_cnt
    from      jamf_erp.shipping_order_logistics_tracking_record aa
    left join jamf_erp.shipping_order                           bb on aa.sales_order_number = bb.sales_order_number and aa.inner_shipping_order_number = bb.inner_shipping_order_number and bb.deleted = 0
    left join jamf_erp.sales_order                              cc on cc.sales_order_number = bb.sales_order_number and cc.deleted = 0
    where     aa.deleted = 0
      and     cc.sales_status = 4
      and     bb.package_type = 2
      and     upper(bb.logistics_provider_code) in ('ONTRAC','FEDEX')
      and     cast(convert_tz(cc.platform_order_create_time,'UTC','America/Los_Angeles') as date) >= '2026-05-01'
      and     cast(convert_tz(cc.platform_order_create_time,'UTC','America/Los_Angeles') as date) <= '2026-06-30'
      and     aa.tracking_number is not null
      and     aa.tracking_number <> ''
    group by
        aa.tracking_number
),
b_source as (
    select
        aa.tracking_number                                          as tracking_number,
        min(aa.platform_order_number)                               as platform_order_number,
        min(upper(aa.logistics_carrier_code))                       as logistics_carrier_code,
        min(aa.shop_code)                                           as shop_code,
        min(aa.warehouse_code)                                      as warehouse_code,
        min(aa.zone)                                                as zone,
        count(*)                                                    as source_row_cnt
    from      jamf_dw.dwd_shipping_order_info aa
    where     upper(aa.logistics_carrier_code) in ('ONTRAC','FEDEX')
      and     aa.package_type_desc = 'SFP'
      and     aa.us_platform_order_create_date >= '2026-05-01'
      and     aa.us_platform_order_create_date <= '2026-06-30'
      and     aa.reissue_flag_desc = '不补发'
      and     aa.ship_status_desc = '已发货'
      and     aa.tracking_number is not null
      and     aa.tracking_number <> ''
    group by
        aa.tracking_number
),
tracking_dim as (
    select tracking_number from a_source
    union
    select tracking_number from b_source
),
diff_detail as (
    select
        case when b.tracking_number is null then 'only_dwd'
             when c.tracking_number is null then 'only_erp'
             else 'both'
        end                                                         as diff_type,
        a.tracking_number                                           as tracking_number,
        nvl(c.source_row_cnt,0)                                     as erp_row_cnt,
        nvl(b.source_row_cnt,0)                                     as dwd_row_cnt,
        c.platform_order_number                                     as erp_platform_order_number,
        b.platform_order_number                                     as dwd_platform_order_number,
        c.logistics_carrier_code                                    as erp_carrier_code,
        b.logistics_carrier_code                                    as dwd_carrier_code,
        c.shop_code                                                 as erp_shop_code,
        b.shop_code                                                 as dwd_shop_code,
        c.warehouse_code                                            as erp_warehouse_code,
        b.warehouse_code                                            as dwd_warehouse_code
    from      tracking_dim a
    left join b_source     b on a.tracking_number = b.tracking_number
    left join a_source     c on a.tracking_number = c.tracking_number
)
select
    aa.diff_type                                                    as diff_type,
    count(*) over(partition by aa.diff_type)                        as diff_tracking_cnt,
    aa.tracking_number                                              as tracking_number,
    aa.erp_row_cnt                                                  as erp_row_cnt,
    aa.dwd_row_cnt                                                  as dwd_row_cnt,
    aa.erp_platform_order_number                                    as erp_platform_order_number,
    aa.dwd_platform_order_number                                    as dwd_platform_order_number,
    aa.erp_carrier_code                                             as erp_carrier_code,
    aa.dwd_carrier_code                                             as dwd_carrier_code,
    aa.erp_shop_code                                                as erp_shop_code,
    aa.dwd_shop_code                                                as dwd_shop_code,
    aa.erp_warehouse_code                                           as erp_warehouse_code,
    aa.dwd_warehouse_code                                           as dwd_warehouse_code
from      diff_detail aa
where     aa.diff_type <> 'both'
order by
    aa.diff_type,
    aa.tracking_number
limit 200
